data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's prior underwriting years showed little aggregate movement in the older claims development triangle (no material net change for underwriting years 2016-2019). However, specific prior-year pressures were identified on the 2019/2020 years, notably an GBP 8.2m strengthening of COVID-related reserves (now GBP 19.1m gross) and further adverse development from the Iowa derecho (~GBP 2.3m), principally affecting the property reinsurance account. Several 2021 catastrophe events (Winter Storm Uri, Hurricane Ida and others) also impacted recoveries and year allocation. Overall the report evidences both event-driven reserve strengthening on select prior years and otherwise broadly flat development across older years.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet prior-year comparative column (142,225k = GBP 142.225m). The Technical Provisions note shows At 1 January 2021 = 144,225k suggesting a small OCR/label discrepancy between tables; chosen primary source per instructions was the Balance Sheet. No single explicit gross 'Movement in prior year's provision' note was found; the gross claims development triangle (gross) was used (excluded 2020 and 2021 columns per rules) which yields zero net movement for underwriting years 2016-2019. Narrative explicitly quantifies gross increases for COVID reserves (+GBP 8.2m) and the Iowa derecho (+GBP 2.3m) which affect 2019/2020; those event-level amounts were captured separately. Where figures are taken from narrative rather than a dedicated gross movement table this is noted in confidence and in these data quality notes.
